major_00.name: THE FOOL
major_00.upright: Act before fear sets in. It is time to open up your destiny and challenge yourself with confidence and a free spirit.
major_00.reversed: Lack of courage or a reckless impulse. Study the ground carefully before you leap into the dark.

major_01.name: THE MAGICIAN
major_01.upright: Time to show your originality. You hold every tool and the power to transform the world around you.
major_01.reversed: Wasted talent or an illusion of control. Review your plans honestly so you can correct your course.

major_02.name: THE HIGH PRIESTESS
major_02.upright: Listen to your deepest intuition and notice the secrets not yet revealed to ordinary eyes.
major_02.reversed: Inner noise and tangled secrets. Make room for silence to find your spiritual clarity again.

major_03.name: THE EMPRESS
major_03.upright: Tend to what matters with love. Your projects and bonds bloom when they get care, presence and dedication.
major_03.reversed: Creative block or giving too much of yourself. Set gentle boundaries and allow yourself to rest.

major_04.name: THE EMPEROR
major_04.upright: Organize your resources and lead with firmness, protecting your foundations and keeping things stable.
major_04.reversed: Rigid thinking and suffocating control. Rethink your demands so you don't push away the people walking with you.

major_05.name: THE HIEROPHANT
major_05.upright: Seek knowledge from wise sources and find solid support in your core values and principles.
major_05.reversed: Outdated dogmas and rules that no longer serve you. Question old patterns without losing respect.

major_06.name: THE LOVERS
major_06.upright: Harmony is in the air. Follow your heart and nurture true connections that light up your path.
major_06.reversed: Inner doubts and dangerous distractions. Beware of impulsive choices made in the heat of the moment.

major_07.name: THE CHARIOT
major_07.upright: Move forward with focus and a firm grip on the reins. Your discipline will steer even opposing forces to triumph.
major_07.reversed: Scattered haste and a lost sense of direction. Slow down to regain control of your actions.

major_08.name: STRENGTH
major_08.upright: True strength is born from serenity, kindness and self-control. Tame your inner beasts with gentleness.
major_08.reversed: Insecurity and explosive reactions. Take a deep breath and reconnect with your inner calm before you answer.

major_09.name: THE HERMIT
major_09.upright: Step away from outside noise to find the answer shining in the lantern of your own soul.
major_09.reversed: Bitter isolation and refusing help. Don't mistake a wise retreat for running away from healthy company.

major_10.name: WHEEL OF FORTUNE
major_10.upright: The tide is turning in your favor. Embrace the natural flow of life and seize new opportunities.
major_10.reversed: Resisting change and feeling unlucky. Accept the ups and downs to move through life more lightly.

major_11.name: JUSTICE
major_11.upright: Face the truth with integrity and clear eyes. Act fairly and reap the rewards of ethical balance.
major_11.reversed: Bias and avoided responsibilities. Own your mistakes with courage to restore order.

major_12.name: THE HANGED MAN
major_12.upright: Take a voluntary pause. Looking at the situation from another angle will reveal a solution that seemed invisible.
major_12.reversed: Stubborn stagnation and pointless sacrifice. Let go of what is no longer up to you and move on.

major_13.name: DEATH
major_13.upright: A cycle closes for good to make room for something new. Welcome the transformation with courage.
major_13.reversed: Clinging to the past and fear of the new. Letting the old die is the only way to allow rebirth.

major_14.name: TEMPERANCE
major_14.upright: Blend rhythms, ideas and emotions with serenity. Patient balance builds something noble and lasting.
major_14.reversed: Excess, imbalance and impatience. Readjust your daily doses to recover your peace.

major_15.name: THE DEVIL
major_15.upright: Acknowledge your shadows and intense passions. Find the chains that you yourself can untie.
major_15.reversed: Freedom from addictions and illusions. Clear awareness starts breaking old chains.

major_16.name: THE TOWER
major_16.upright: Fragile structures suddenly fall to reveal the truth. The storm clears the ground for real foundations.
major_16.reversed: Delaying the inevitable only drags out the collapse. Face the changes you need without clinging to ruins.

major_17.name: THE STAR
major_17.upright: Serenity returns with a breath of hope and renewal. Trust your light and a promising future.
major_17.reversed: Passing discouragement and disbelief. Remember that the darkest night always comes before dawn.

major_18.name: THE MOON
major_18.upright: Not everything is what it seems. Sail the mysterious waters of the mind trusting your instinct, without illusions.
major_18.reversed: The fog lifts and baseless fears lose their power. The light of truth brings instant relief.

major_19.name: THE SUN
major_19.upright: Light, warmth and radiant fulfillment. Celebrate your victories and share your contagious enthusiasm.
major_19.reversed: Small clouds cover the sun for a while. Don't let tiredness dim the joy you have earned.

major_20.name: JUDGEMENT
major_20.upright: Hear the call to a new life. Forgive the past, learn its lessons and rise again fully aware.
major_20.reversed: Harsh self-criticism and hesitation in the face of change. Free yourself from old guilt and answer the call.

major_21.name: THE WORLD
major_21.upright: A complete cycle and total success. Feel the fullness of the journey you have walked and celebrate how far you've come.
major_21.reversed: One last detail is missing to finish the work. Don't give up on the final stretch; wrap up what's pending.

wands_01.name: ACE OF WANDS
wands_01.upright: A creative spark lights up great passions. Start your new project boldly and with grit.
wands_01.reversed: Lack of initiative or blocked energy. Rekindle the flame of purpose before you act.

wands_02.name: TWO OF WANDS
wands_02.upright: The world is in your hands. Plan your next step with strategic vision and healthy ambition.
wands_02.reversed: Fear of the unknown and hesitation to expand. Trust your ability to explore new horizons.

wands_03.name: THREE OF WANDS
wands_03.upright: Your ships are on their way with good news. Keep your eyes on the horizon and celebrate your progress.
wands_03.reversed: Unexpected delays test your patience. Stay on course without losing your enthusiasm.

wands_04.name: FOUR OF WANDS
wands_04.upright: Reasons to celebrate with family or dear friends. Enjoy the peace and security you have earned.
wands_04.reversed: Small frictions at home. Value open conversation and strengthen your nest.

wands_05.name: FIVE OF WANDS
wands_05.upright: Fierce rivalries and a stimulating exchange of ideas. Use the friction to sharpen your strengths.
wands_05.reversed: Pointless fights drain your energy. Pick your battles and step away from petty drama.

wands_06.name: SIX OF WANDS
wands_06.upright: Public triumph and well-earned applause. Accept recognition with dignity and gratitude to your allies.
wands_06.reversed: An excessive need for approval or a fleeting win. Focus on real merit, not just the applause.

wands_07.name: SEVEN OF WANDS
wands_07.upright: Defend your position with conviction. You have the upper hand even when surrounded by challenges.
wands_07.reversed: Feeling overwhelmed by criticism. Protect your energy and decide what is worth defending.

wands_08.name: EIGHT OF WANDS
wands_08.upright: Fast events and important messages in the air. The flow is speeding up in your favor, get ready!
wands_08.reversed: Rushing things causes misunderstandings. Slow down so you don't trample crucial decisions.

wands_09.name: NINE OF WANDS
wands_09.upright: You are almost at the finish line. Keep your guard up and persist until the final victory.
wands_09.reversed: Paranoia or built-up exhaustion. Rest a little so you don't see danger where there is only fatigue.

wands_10.name: TEN OF WANDS
wands_10.upright: Too many responsibilities weigh on your shoulders. Learn to delegate and drop the burden that isn't yours.
wands_10.reversed: The excess weight could break your back. Get rid of unnecessary commitments now.

wands_page.name: PAGE OF WANDS
wands_page.upright: Inspiring news awakens the urge to explore. Try new paths with childlike joy.
wands_page.reversed: Immaturity and half-finished projects. Truly commit to what you start.

wands_knight.name: KNIGHT OF WANDS
wands_knight.upright: A brave and passionate advance. Chase your goals with irresistible intensity and focus on the target.
wands_knight.reversed: Blind impulsiveness and a volatile temper. Think before you burn bridges along the way.

wands_queen.name: QUEEN OF WANDS
wands_queen.upright: Radiant magnetism and warm leadership. Your natural confidence attracts admirers and opportunities.
wands_queen.reversed: Envy or the need to control everything. Shine without having to outshine the people around you.

wands_king.name: KING OF WANDS
wands_king.upright: Lead with greatness and turn big ideas into concrete reality. Be the example others follow.
wands_king.reversed: Authoritarianism and unrealistic expectations. Lead with empathy to keep your team's respect.

cups_01.name: ACE OF CUPS
cups_01.upright: The cup of emotions overflows with affection, peace and inspiration. Open your heart to new, pure feelings.
cups_01.reversed: Repressed feelings or emotional neediness. Take care of yourself before filling someone else's cup.

cups_02.name: TWO OF CUPS
cups_02.upright: A meeting of souls and mutual respect. A sincere encounter seals a harmonious and thriving bond.
cups_02.reversed: Disagreements and being out of sync. Talk openly to align expectations and feelings.

cups_03.name: THREE OF CUPS
cups_03.upright: Raise a toast with the people you love! True friendship and joyful teamwork bring lightness to the heart.
cups_03.reversed: Social excess or toxic cliques. Nurture friendships that truly support you.

cups_04.name: FOUR OF CUPS
cups_04.upright: Look around: a new opportunity is being offered, but your discouragement may keep you from seeing it.
cups_04.reversed: Leaving apathy behind with renewed interest in life. Accept the invitations the universe sends you.

cups_05.name: FIVE OF CUPS
cups_05.upright: Don't only cry over the spilled cups; two untouched cups stand right behind you, waiting for your gaze.
cups_05.reversed: Moving through grief and embracing the present. The heart heals and opens up to life again.

cups_06.name: SIX OF CUPS
cups_06.upright: Sweet memories of the past warm the soul. Reconnect with the purity and tenderness of your roots.
cups_06.reversed: Being stuck in an idealized past keeps you from living the real present. Look ahead with kindness.

cups_07.name: SEVEN OF CUPS
cups_07.upright: Many castles in the air and tempting options. Keep your feet on the ground to choose what is real and lasting.
cups_07.reversed: Mental clarity after a season of illusions. Make practical, objective choices.

cups_08.name: EIGHT OF CUPS
cups_08.upright: Time to leave behind what no longer fills your soul. Walk toward higher horizons.
cups_08.reversed: Fear of leaving or clinging to empty situations. Have the courage to seek your true happiness.

cups_09.name: NINE OF CUPS
cups_09.upright: The wish card! Enjoy emotional satisfaction, comfort and well-deserved joy.
cups_09.reversed: Complacency or excessive vanity. Don't settle for shallow pleasures when you can have fulfillment.

cups_10.name: TEN OF CUPS
cups_10.upright: Fulfillment and well-being at home. Shared love and a rainbow of blessings for you and yours.
cups_10.reversed: Small disagreements at home. Make time to restore warmth and mutual listening.

cups_page.name: PAGE OF CUPS
cups_page.upright: A sweet message of affection or a poetic spark. Let your dreamy imagination guide your heart.
cups_page.reversed: Oversensitivity or naivety. Protect your emotions from empty illusions.

cups_knight.name: KNIGHT OF CUPS
cups_knight.upright: A messenger of love brings noble invitations and charming proposals. Follow your poetic quest.
cups_knight.reversed: Romantic promises with no basis in reality. Watch people's actions before handing over your trust.

cups_queen.name: QUEEN OF CUPS
cups_queen.upright: Deep emotional wisdom and loving support. Your compassion heals everyone who comes close.
cups_queen.reversed: Too much vulnerability or smothering attachment. Look after your own well before it overflows.

cups_king.name: KING OF CUPS
cups_king.upright: Emotional maturity that calms storms. Lead with diplomacy, wisdom and serene kindness.
cups_king.reversed: Emotional repression or subtle manipulation. Connect with the honesty of your feelings.

swords_01.name: ACE OF SWORDS
swords_01.upright: The sword of truth cuts through every lie and confusion. A brilliant idea paves the way to victory.
swords_01.reversed: Words that are too sharp or a clouded mind. Use logic with empathy so you don't hurt anyone needlessly.

swords_02.name: TWO OF SWORDS
swords_02.upright: A delicate balance between two options. Take off the blindfold and calmly make the decision you need to make.
swords_02.reversed: Running from an urgent choice. Putting off the inevitable only adds pressure to your mind.

swords_03.name: THREE OF SWORDS
swords_03.upright: A disappointment hurts, but it clears away illusions that held you back. Let yourself feel so real healing can begin.
swords_03.reversed: Old wounds are healing. Forgiveness and time rebuild peace in the heart.

swords_04.name: FOUR OF SWORDS
swords_04.upright: Step away from the battle to rest your mind. Restorative silence renews your strength.
swords_04.reversed: Time to get up from rest and return to the world with a rested mind and a renewed spirit.

swords_05.name: FIVE OF SWORDS
swords_05.upright: Not every victory is worth the relationships it destroys. Choose peace before insisting on being right.
swords_05.reversed: A wish to reconcile and move past hurt. Set your pride aside and make peace.

swords_06.name: SIX OF SWORDS
swords_06.upright: Crossing over to calmer times. Leave the rough sea behind and head toward smooth waters.
swords_06.reversed: Heavy emotional baggage slows the crossing. Let go of the past to sail more lightly.

swords_07.name: SEVEN OF SWORDS
swords_07.upright: Act with intelligence and discretion. A strategic approach will solve more than a head-on clash.
swords_07.reversed: Secrets revealed or plans that need transparency. Choose clear honesty.

swords_08.name: EIGHT OF SWORDS
swords_08.upright: The ties that bind you are made by your own beliefs. Take a step: you are free to walk out.
swords_08.reversed: Breaking mental barriers and getting your autonomy back. The way out was always within reach.

swords_09.name: NINE OF SWORDS
swords_09.upright: Sleepless nights and worries inflated by fear. Remember: the monsters of the mind shrink in daylight.
swords_09.reversed: The mental storm starts to clear. Reach out for support and notice that the worst is over.

swords_10.name: TEN OF SWORDS
swords_10.upright: Rock bottom is behind you; the pain is over. A new dawn is already breaking on the horizon.
swords_10.reversed: Recovering after a bitter fall. Breathe deeply: life comes back stronger after the fall.

swords_page.name: PAGE OF SWORDS
swords_page.upright: A sharp mind that notices everything. Use your thirst for knowledge to learn and uncover new truths.
swords_page.reversed: Gossip, impulsive comments or paranoia. Filter information before you spread it.

swords_knight.name: KNIGHT OF SWORDS
swords_knight.upright: A determined charge toward the goal with lightning-fast thinking. Defend your ideals firmly.
swords_knight.reversed: Aggressive haste that runs over others. Use your intelligence without being harsh.

swords_queen.name: QUEEN OF SWORDS
swords_queen.upright: Crystal-clear thinking and flawless judgment. Be fair, objective and protective of your truth.
swords_queen.reversed: Bitter coldness or defensive cynicism. Warm your reason with a touch of compassion.

swords_king.name: KING OF SWORDS
swords_king.upright: Ethical command and an extraordinary power of analysis. Make decisions grounded in truth and the greater good.
swords_king.reversed: Inflexibility or abuse of logical power. Don't use your intellect to belittle anyone.

pentacles_01.name: ACE OF PENTACLES
pentacles_01.upright: A golden seed falls into your hands. A concrete opportunity for material prosperity begins.
pentacles_01.reversed: A chance wasted through carelessness or impulsive spending. Handle what you receive responsibly.

pentacles_02.name: TWO OF PENTACLES
pentacles_02.upright: Skillfully juggling your priorities and routine. Adapt to change with lightness and good humor.
pentacles_02.reversed: Financial overload or a disorganized schedule. Set priorities and breathe.

pentacles_03.name: THREE OF PENTACLES
pentacles_03.upright: Teamwork that produces excellence. Your technical skills and dedication are admired.
pentacles_03.reversed: Lack of cooperation or sloppy effort. Join forces with people who add value to the project.

pentacles_04.name: FOUR OF PENTACLES
pentacles_04.upright: Solid material foundations and protecting what you have built. Stay financially prudent.
pentacles_04.reversed: Greedy attachment and fear of scarcity. Remember that wealth has to circulate to create life.

pentacles_05.name: FIVE OF PENTACLES
pentacles_05.upright: A temporary tight spot. Look up: the doors of the sanctuary are open to welcome you.
pentacles_05.reversed: Getting through a crisis and regaining financial stability. The worst period of scarcity is over.

pentacles_06.name: SIX OF PENTACLES
pentacles_06.upright: Generosity that ennobles the soul. Give with joy and receive with dignity; abundance keeps flowing.
pentacles_06.reversed: Unfair demands or favors with hidden motives. Practice selfless kindness.

pentacles_07.name: SEVEN OF PENTACLES
pentacles_07.upright: Look at the garden you planted. The fruit is growing; be patient for a noble harvest.
pentacles_07.reversed: Anxious for a quick harvest or working barren soil. Adjust the plan and keep going.

pentacles_08.name: EIGHT OF PENTACLES
pentacles_08.upright: Artisan focus and constant improvement. Your attention to detail will make you a master of your craft.
pentacles_08.reversed: Mechanical routine with no purpose or paralyzing perfectionism. Work with love, not martyrdom.

pentacles_09.name: NINE OF PENTACLES
pentacles_09.upright: Financial independence and enjoying good taste. You built your own paradise through effort and merit.
pentacles_09.reversed: A look of wealth that hides emptiness or runaway spending. Value true inner peace.

pentacles_10.name: TEN OF PENTACLES
pentacles_10.upright: Generational security, a blessed inheritance and total stability at home. The peak of material and family success.
pentacles_10.reversed: Inheritance disputes or financial instability in the family. Put loving bonds above possessions.

pentacles_page.name: PAGE OF PENTACLES
pentacles_page.upright: An invitation to practical work or study. Learn with discipline and you will harvest gold.
pentacles_page.reversed: Procrastination and lack of method. Organize your routine and focus on the real goal.

pentacles_knight.name: KNIGHT OF PENTACLES
pentacles_knight.upright: A firm, unshakable stride toward the goal. Your reliability and hard work guarantee steady success.
pentacles_knight.reversed: Blind stubbornness or excessive slowness. Be open to more modern and dynamic methods.

pentacles_queen.name: QUEEN OF PENTACLES
pentacles_queen.upright: A fertile hand that makes everything thrive. Care for your body, business and home with generosity and wisdom.
pentacles_queen.reversed: Worrying too much about money or carrying too much care. Save a moment to look after yourself.

pentacles_king.name: KING OF PENTACLES
pentacles_king.upright: A consolidated empire and authority in the business world. Enjoy the solidity and protect what you have achieved.
pentacles_king.reversed: Boundless greed or materialistic rigidity. Remember that nobility lives in character, not in vaults.
